description: Wording for the '复制付款消息' (copy payment message) button in index.html. Edit THIS file to change how the message reads — do not edit index.html for wording changes. {placeholders} are filled in automatically from that member's real order (product name, quantity, unit, amount, adjustment note, actual weight, total) — keep them in the text, just move/reword what's around them. Re-upload this file to the repo root to apply changes; no index.html edit or redeploy of the app itself needed. Matches how WG团购群 already writes these messages by hand: "@name", no emoji, no "$", blank line before the item list and before the total, "一共X～" instead of "合计：$X", and no closing line by default.
